subject: Taxes
title: Pre-Filled Returns Worldwide
description: A short lesson to help you apply Pre-Filled Returns Worldwide.

hook.text: In Estonia, filing taxes takes five minutes. The government pre-fills your return.

buildup.text: Over 40 countries use pre-filled returns: Sweden, Australia, the UK, Japan, Spain.

discovery.text: Pre-filled systems reduce errors by 80% and cut processing costs by half.

twist.text: The US has the data to pre-fill returns for most taxpayers.

climax.text: Tax filing complexity is a political choice, not a technological necessity.

punchline.text: Five minutes in Estonia. Hours in America. A choice, not a necessity.

quiz.question: What is the main obstacle to pre-filled returns in the US?
options: The US tax code is too simple
